capabilities: Assigns a generated or readable key to a note or attachment
Copies obsidian:// permanent links, including to a heading or block
Keys every file in a folder or the whole vault
Follows moves, renames, deletions and restores of keyed files
disambiguation: Not a web-link archiver or broken-link checker; it gives vault files keys so obsidian:// links keep resolving after moves.
extras: Documentation is an interactive demo vault shipped with each release and readable on GitHub; beta builds install through BRAT; the plugin publishes a cross-plugin API (contract 1.1.0) declared in api.d.ts.
intentEvidence: Same goal for links to notes: adds key generation; attachments; an index instead of a scan
motivation: Ids that survive a move are a long-standing request: people in the Obsidian community have asked for them since at least 2021.
problem: Obsidian rewrites links inside the vault when a file moves, but obsidian://open links kept in bookmarks, emails, task trackers or other vaults break on the first move.

relations.evidence: The idea and the shape of the setting come from Vault Permalink Kit

summary: Gives notes and attachments a permanent key on request and copies obsidian:// links that keep opening the file after it moves.
